notes.title: Super Greedy Cat is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to embark on a purrfectly addictive adventure? 
Look no further than Super Greedy Cat! Get ready to explore a colorful world filled with obstacles, enemies, and treasures to collect. 

With intuitive controls and cute, quirky graphics, Super Greedy Cat is the perfect game for all ages. 

Don't miss out on the chance to join the coolest cat around - Super Greedy Cat is available NOW!
